goal: Prevent transaction origin leaks by suppressing wallet rebroadcasts under -privatebroadcast
Protects users relying on private broadcast from exposing sent or received transactions over clearnet
agreement: Contested objection: coupling wallet rebroadcast to -privatebroadcast complicates settings (vasild)
Support because it prevents unexpected rebroadcasts of watch-only or dust transactions (andrewtoth)
Support for eliminating wallet rebroadcasts under private broadcast (davidgumberg)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes a privacy leak where retained unconfirmed transactions are served to peers on request
Protects users from peers inferring node transaction ownership over clearnet

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it eliminates an unexpected rebroadcast footgun when private broadcast is active
Stops unconfirmed or dust transactions from being re-added to the mempool on startup or import
